items.title: 11:23 · Requirement three is a defined flow of
items.detail: Requirement three is a defined flow of inputs and outputs.

items.title: 11:38 · The Elite tier operates as a parasitic
items.detail: The Elite tier operates as a parasitic control gate that directs the high-current labor flow while drawing a small control current through the intermediate tiers.

items.title: 11:48 · The primary output is upward economic extraction
items.detail: The primary output is upward economic extraction E of t captured by the Elite, paired with a downward suppression allocation psi of t, split into psychological status wage psi-sub-s and material concessions psi-sub-m paid to the Buffer Class.

items.title: 12:03 · Under the Concession Theorem in Chapter 19
items.detail: Under the Concession Theorem in Chapter 19, non-kinetic allocations obey the constraint delta max equals zero: they redistribute status and minor concessions without altering the maximum extraction ceiling.
